defect: forwarded-clock sample timing depends on an unspecified board phase relationship
rationale: adc_data is launched by adc_clk and captured by capture_clk without synchronization. Equal nominal periods alone do not establish phase, skew, or setup/hold margins. A board with controlled phase can make this transfer valid; an unrelated or poorly phased clock cannot. No relationship or board timing contract is given.
author: gpt-6.1-sol

labels.by: claude-opus-5-5 (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: 12-bit adc_data crosses from adc_clk to capture_clk with no synchroniser; the two equal-period clocks are declared independently with no stated phase/frequency relationship, so safety depends on an undeclared board clock contract (and the parity reconvergence makes it fatal if they are asynchronous).
